label: Couchbase Lite 4.0
type: Couchbase Lite's own independent version family, sibling of version:cbl-3-3-0.
evidence: Couchbase Lite 4.x is only compatible with Sync Gateway 4.0 and later. Connecting Couchbase Lite 4.x to Sync Gateway versions before 4.0 is not supported.
note: First contact with the client-version half of the CBL/SGW compatibility matrix (round 3's CBL sampling never reached version-specific pages). Two relations in product-notes/compatibility.json (availableSince version:sgw-4-0; doesNotSupport against version:sgw-3-3-0) plus a third in server-compatibility/server-compatibility-xdcr-mobile.json (requiresCapability sgw:bidirectional-xdcr, the only CBL version stated to support cluster-switching without consistency issues).
